text: Titan Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Redemption of Commercial Paper
nse_summary: Titan Company Limited has fully redeemed its Commercial Papers with a face value of 1000 crore rupees. The securities carry the ISIN code INE280A14617 and were originally issued on 14th August 2026. The company confirms that maturity proceeds have been paid to all holders on 12th November 2026. This intimation is issued in compliance with SEBI Operational Circular No. SEBI/HO/DDHS/P/CIR/2021/613 dated 10th August 2021. A copy of the notice is available on the company website at www.titancompany.in. The communication was signed by Dinesh Shetty, General Counsel and Company Secretary.

text: Titan Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of Analyst / Institutional Investor Meeting
nse_summary: Titan Company Limited has disclosed the schedule for analyst and institutional investor meetings in November 2026. On 20-Nov-26, Schroder Investment Management Singapore will hold a one-on-one physical meeting from 10:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. On 26-Nov-26, Qatar Investment Authority will hold a one-on-one physical meeting from 2:30 p.m. to 3:30 p.m. These meetings are in addition to those disclosed earlier. No price sensitive information or forward-looking statements will be discussed. The schedule may change due to exigencies.

text: Titan Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Earnings Call Transcripts
nse_summary: Titan Company Limited filed a notice with BSE and NSE on 11th November 2026 regarding the transcript of the Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 5th November 2026. The transcript discusses unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Management reported consolidated growth driven by innovation. Titan Jewellery recorded a customs duty gain of Rs. 490 crores, while CaratLane recorded Rs. 46 crores. Normalized margins were stated as 11.1% for Titan Jewellery and 11.7% after adjusting for mark-to-market reversals. A fair value adjustment of Rs. 671 crores was recognized on the Damas acquisition liability. Management noted festive season trends showed strong starts and endings with softness in between due to gold price volatility. Investment buying remained soft, while studded jewellery demand was strong. Lower caratage jewellery adoption continues as a strategic long-term initiative. The board has approved raising Rs. 2,500 crores for replenishing existing borrowing.
